cohort: 45 ASD children aged 6-9 years and 90 sex- and age-matched neurotypical controls
finding: Fecal short-chain fatty acid levels were not significantly associated with the presence of ASD in Chinese children aged 6-9 years old.
mod_finding: The study adjusted for mode of delivery as a potential confounder but did not report any specific findings related to mode of delivery and fecal SCFA concentrations.
